name: dev.brandpilot/brandpilot-mcp
description: BrandPilot design systems for coding agents: tokens, design handoff bundle, prompt pack, import.

environmentVariables.name: BRANDPILOT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Workspace API key (bp_live_...) from BrandPilot. When set, the server proxies to the hosted BrandPilot MCP and serves its full tool list.

environmentVariables.name: BRANDPILOT_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Hosted MCP endpoint used with BRANDPILOT_API_KEY. Defaults to https://brandpilot.dev/api/mcp.

environmentVariables.name: BRANDPILOT_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.description: BrandPilot origin the server talks to. Defaults to https://brandpilot.dev.

environmentVariables.name: DESIGNFLOW_HANDOFF_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Deprecated legacy design handoff key, retired on 2027-01-31; use BRANDPILOT_API_KEY. Ignored when BRANDPILOT_API_KEY is set.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by a workspace API key from BrandPilot (Settings, API keys), e.g. "Bearer bp_live_..."
